steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You have already intervened once, and made an attempt to destroy the altar. Yet you were unable to eliminate them entirely.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those phantoms have already been scattered. Now we just need to find Lichen—

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: That line of "truth" has a second half.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: "When form is masterless, all longings seek one of their own."

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Which is to say, without a vessel to bind them, those phantoms will only grow more restless. They will seek out the next tangible form to latch onto.

The phantoms pour past you in a frenzy, flooding the passage ahead. You watch the river of pale cyan, and a cold weight sinks through your chest. They're hunting for a living vessel to latch onto. Any of you could serve, including Lichen.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So there's no way out at all, then?! They accounted for everything!
You aren't sure who you mean by "them." Is it the presence that whispered from the altar? Is it fate itself? The answer feels irrelevant. You're past the point of caring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These rules they've set... are they even right?! You heard those voices too, didn't you? And you're just going to accept that? Is this what you would call fate?!

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Yes. You have seen it for yourself, and you have made your attempt. It is time to recognize when to yield.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Rules exist for a reason. They are not so easily crossed.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I had thought you would prove different from her in the end. That you would understand the cost, respect the weight of the rules, and know when you had reached your limit. Unlike her, forever lost in her own delusions.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: If you are just as obstinate as she is, then I will send you back.
His arm lifts again. Your fist tightens as you fix your gaze on the blade suspended in the air, its edges limned by swirling crimson fire and dancing sparks.
You track its arc, waiting for the strike aimed directly at you.
